briefTitle: A First in Human Study of ALX2004 With Advanced or Metastatic Selected Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: NSCLC - For participants with a targetable molecular alteration: received appropriate standard targeted therapy and no more than 2 prior lines of systemic chemotherapy in the advanced/metastatic setting. For participants without a targetable molecular alteration: received platinum-based chemotherapy and CPI (in combination or separately), and have received no more than 2 prior lines of systemic chemotherapy in the advanced/metastatic setting
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior line requirements and prior therapies differ based on tumor subtype and molecular alteration status, preventing a simple universal typed check.
Qualitative bone marrow function without specific numeric cutoffs is subjective.
Qualitative renal and liver function without specific lab cutoffs is subjective.
General adequate performance status without a specific scale or numeric threshold cannot be expressed as a typed ECOG check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a life expectancy of less than 3 months and/or has rapidly progressing disease (e.g., tumor bleeding, uncontrolled tumor pain) in the opinion of the treating investigator
